rows.coder_note: Abstract names GWAS meta-analyses of the MVP, UK Biobank and FinnGen; one candidate row is a meta-analysis of those three sources, but no FinnGen release is stated, so the release is not identified.

rows.quote: Methods: Using cis-acting plasma protein quantitative-trait loci for 2,478 circulating proteins, we performed two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) against a composite kidney-function trait integrating baseline eGFR, incident chronic kidney disease, end-stage kidney disease, and annualized eGFR slope estimated using linear mixed-effects modeling from 464,631 Veterans Affairs Million Veteran Program (MVP) participants.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the kidney-function trait data from 464,631 Million Veteran Program participants as the MR outcome; the dictionary has no row for an MVP dataset alone.
UK Biobank is named only as a part of GWAS meta-analyses with MVP and FinnGen; no UK Biobank release, pipeline or citation is stated.
